title: Cast, NPC Agenda, Relationship & Callback Planning
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Cast, NPC Agenda, Relationship and Callback Planning over the MAS-01..06 foundations, consuming explicit Character/NPC/Creature/Relationship and prepared Adventure references without creating a parallel NPC generator, relationship authority or live callback runtime.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared cast composition, NPC agendas, relationship references and callback planning inside the MAS workspace while preserving canonical Character/NPC/Creature/Relationship and runtime owner authority.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically plan cast, NPC agendas, relationships and callbacks through explicit canonical owner references over MAS-01..06 foundations while preserving owner-domain and runtime authority and never treating prepared agendas, relationships or callbacks as executed live truth.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 workspace/document authority through MAS-06 prepared investigation design remain foundational and were not reopened.
Character, NPC and Creature owner domains retain canonical identity/state authority; Relationship/MIB-09 retains relationship state/history/mutation authority.
MAS-07 consumes explicit validated Character/NPC/Creature/Relationship bindings and prepared MAS-06 Adventure references; dangling or wrong-domain references fail closed.
Prepared NPC agendas never prove live NPC intent or action; prepared callbacks never prove callback/dialogue/effect execution.
MAS-07 does not evaluate callback predicates, apply MIB-09 relationship events, emit Action/Event truth or mutate canonical owner state.
Existing MAS validation family remained active; no family transition occurred in MAS-07.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-07, including current MSLR planning; no new cross-program rotation is unlocked, so MAS-08 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-09+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: MAS-07 is closed. MAS-08 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
